discussion_comments.comment_body: On LM Studio's `/api/v0/models`, `max_context_length` is the model's ceiling, and a loaded model also reports `loaded_context_length`, which is what it actually serves (can be a lot smaller). Since maxInputTokens falls back to contextWindow and that's the compaction budget, compaction won't kick in before LM Studio starts rejecting. Prefer `loaded_context_length` when it's present?

That case exercised none of Cline's routing; it only pinned how `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` translates an id it classifies itself, which belongs to the adapter's own suite. This is about the shape of the usage object, not the installed AI SDK version: if a finish part still reaches normalizeUsage with reasoning under outputTokens.reasoning and no raw provider metadata, our current path misses it and leaves those tokens in outputTokens. I’ll add support for that nested field and a positive-reasoning regression test.
